bootcamp.scenario_note: Fixed by the skill, not chosen. Unlike the Debugging and Production Readiness skills, this one does NOT fork the LinkOps checkpoint -- team collaboration (teams, roles, invites, comment threads, activity feed, audit log) is a different product. Recording that so nobody later assumes the api/ tree implements it.
bootcamp.relationship_to_existing_work: The LinkOps service supplies the constraints I will feed as context rather than the code: RLS-enforced tenant isolation (handlers must not filter by tenant_id), required-no-default configuration, secrets never in errors, and controls that must be watched failing. Those transfer; the schema does not.

pretest.stated_weakness: Failures are not bad model outputs; they are accepting a plausible result without verifying it came from the thing that changed. Two instances this week: debugging a server that had never restarted, and trusting a .dockerignore that did not do what it claimed.
